purpose: Editable anatomical, equipment and action guides only. Not painted masters, selected resources or accepted artwork.

provenance.method: New project-authored volumetric geometry and skeletal poses; no imported Demacia/original mesh, sprite, texture or generated image

native.basis: Demacia read-only measured native pipeline and extracted cpkman reference; remeasure target identity during painted/native review
native.shadow: No baked floor or shadow in transparent guides; final battle generateShadow=1, generateOverlay=1

emblem.policy: Leave emblem fields blank in guides. Obtain a genuine official Riot Noxus emblem, preserve exact source URL/bytes/hash and permissions before final painted art. Never invent a crest or reuse Demacia heraldry.

painting_contract.required_capability: ChatGPT image-generation skill / built-in image_gen.imagegen or human painted masters
painting_contract.style: Original Heroes III native painted/prerendered treatment, restrained highlights, matte iron/crimson/black, upper-left lighting; not glossy modern 3D, flat vector or splash art
painting_contract.continuity: Use each unit's own model/upgrade definition and all actual pose guides; preserve joint contacts and independent silhouettes
painting_contract.camera: One measured uniform camera/placement correction per action atlas, preserve every source and rejected revision; no per-frame stretch, warping, auto-fit or idle-as-action
review: transparent background and no baked floor
whole action semantics and projectile release
genuine Noxus emblem legibility and provenance

legionRecruit.silhouette: Open iron cap, short quilted crimson coat, plain narrow iron buckler, work boots and one short forward cleaver; offensive recruit, not Demacian shield-first recruit

legionVeteran.silhouette: Closed practical faceguard, angular iron cuirass, layered right pauldron, split knee-length tassets and broader cleaver; changed armour outline, not recolour
legionVeteran.weakness: No free defensive aura or shield-stance package

drakeHound.silhouette: Riderless low reptilian quadruped; long narrow snout, bent rear hocks, single head, splayed claws, low dorsal ridges and tapering tail
drakeHound.weakness: Fast flank access with ordinary retaliation, no flight or three-headed strike
drakeHound.lore: Drake-hound inspired project troop, not Skaarl

armoredDrakeHound.silhouette: Broader neck with articulated iron skull cap, three separate shoulder/rib saddle plates, low harness spikes and reinforced foreclaw cuffs; no rider or horse tack
armoredDrakeHound.weakness: Grounded contact fighter; no safe free attack

axeReckoner.silhouette: Broad human arena fighter, exposed throwing arm, leather chest straps, small off-shoulder plate, one simple single-bit throwing axe held at a time and spare axes in hip rack
axeReckoner.weakness: Finite ammunition, one throw, ordinary distance/wall penalties and separate close chop
axeReckoner.lore: Project adaptation of Reckoning arena fighters, not Draven, paired spinning axes or a canonical imperial regiment

veteranAxeReckoner.silhouette: Caged iron brow helmet, broad asymmetric shoulder guard, diagonal torso plates, heavier greaves and wedge-headed single throwing axe; larger protected outline and changed equipment
veteranAxeReckoner.weakness: No double throw, catch reset, extra action or spinning champion axes

roseSpellblade.silhouette: Narrow hooded occult agent, asymmetric split black coat, practical dark leather and one low curved blade; open offhand performs grounded departure/arrival ward
roseSpellblade.weakness: Fragile contact fighter; native speed-limited teleport and ordinary retaliation
roseSpellblade.lore: Black Rose inspired project fiction; teleport is gameplay adaptation, not universal canonical cabal power or LeBlanc clone

roseInfiltrator.silhouette: High rigid collar replaces hood, half-mask, reinforced right shoulder, long uneven two-panel coat and offhand hooked parrying dagger; no bright staff, crown or clone silhouette
roseInfiltrator.weakness: No automatic no-retaliation, dispel, free action or fake flight

crimsonDisciple.silhouette: Human lesser hemomancer, low cowl, long practical crimson robe split for visible walking feet, leather vial belt and one bare channeling hand; separate knife melee
crimsonDisciple.weakness: Ordinary ranged damage with ammunition; no drain, resurrection or blood economy
crimsonDisciple.lore: Plural lesser hemomancer project ranks, not Vladimir transformation or an obedient canonical imperial ministry

crimsonAdept.silhouette: Open angular headwrap, broad layered black mantle, segmented shoulder bands, reinforced forearm and three hanging ampoules; wider upper silhouette with long uneven robe panels
crimsonAdept.weakness: Distinct one-charge action-cost Basic Curse casting pose; no free cast or transformation

minotaurReckoner.silhouette: Living massive bovine arena bruiser, low heavy muzzle, outward curved horns, broad bare neck/chest, short cloven hooves, leather arena girdle and long two-grip iron maul
minotaurReckoner.weakness: Ordinary retaliation, no defense penetration or execution
minotaurReckoner.lore: Individual Noxian arena/service adaptation, not Alistar or universal imperial minotaur loyalty

veteranMinotaur.silhouette: Wider bovine body, horn cuffs, one massive iron shoulder, layered belt/tassets and long broad transverse cleaving axe; physical rear-hex sweep poses, not recolour
veteranMinotaur.weakness: Cleave follows physical line and can hit friend behind primary target; no safe selective area attack

ruinBringer.silhouette: Predatory hunched shadow demon, small low forward skull, extremely long clawed forelimbs, bent planted hind legs, ragged black mantle and sparse crimson fissures; iron binding straps, no stone or robot armour
ruinBringer.weakness: Grounded twohex walking routes, restricted mobility and ordinary retaliation; no inherited Colossus protection
ruinBringer.lore: Atakhan-inspired recruitable bound-demon contingent is project fiction, not canonical species, copied unique Atakhan, breeding programme or soul economy

greaterRuinBringer.silhouette: Larger wider hunched manifestation, extended scapular spines and asymmetric back crown, doubled diagonal binding harness, deeper split mantle and longer low claws; bodily and restraint changes, not stone robot or recolour
greaterRuinBringer.weakness: Grounded non-living; no flight, teleport, shooter, resurrection, spell shell or kill scaling
greaterRuinBringer.lore: Project-fiction stronger manifestation, not a canonical hierarchy or Atakhan Thornbound identity
